title: Why Blog Posts Matter
learningGoal: Understand why creating blog posts helps your business.

items.title: Build Trust
items.description: Blog posts help potential customers learn about your expertise before they ever talk to you.

items.title: Get Found Online
items.description: Each blog post is a chance to show up in Google when people search for topics related to your business.

items.title: Support Your Follow-Up
items.description: When you follow up with leads, sharing a helpful blog post gives them value instead of just asking for a sale.

keyPoint: You do not need to be a professional writer. Content that is clear and helpful beats perfect content that never gets published.

actionSteps.title: Think of one question your customers ask often
actionSteps.description: This will be the topic for your first blog post

actionSteps.title: Write down a simple answer
actionSteps.description: Keep it conversational, like you are explaining to a friend

actionSteps.title: Keep it ready for the next lesson
actionSteps.description: We will turn this into a full blog post

quizzes.question: What is the main benefit of blog posts for your business?

options.option_text: They build trust and help you get found online
They are only for professional writers

quizzes.explanation: Blog posts help build trust with potential customers and improve your visibility in search engines.

title: Planning Your Blog Post
learningGoal: Plan a simple blog post that answers one customer question.

items.title: Pick One Question
items.description: Choose one question your customers ask. Examples: How do I know if I need...? What is the difference between...?

items.title: Write a Simple Title
items.description: Use the question as your title or turn it into a statement. Example: 5 Signs You Need a New Roof

items.title: Outline 3-5 Key Points
items.description: Break your answer into a few short sections. Each section should be 2-4 sentences.

keyPoint: A good blog post does not need to be long. It needs to be clear and helpful.

actionSteps.title: List 3-5 key points you will cover

quizzes.question: How many key points should your blog post outline include?
quizzes.explanation: A good blog post has 3-5 key points to keep it focused and easy to read.
